stages.label: 准备、补测试与审查
stages.description: 发现完整功能、设计开发任务、核对原版基线，并补强优化器更新、HTTP 与浏览器调优测试。新增测试的可移植性经过多轮修正和独立复核，直到第 6 位准备阶段 helper 审查结束。
stages.detail: 这个阶段约占运行时间的 56%。原版基线因检查定义和测试变更共执行 5 轮。出题与发现部分并行，不能把所有 Agent 时长直接相加。

stages.label: 首版重写与整合
stages.description: runtime、text、speech、apps 四个实现部分并行推进，再运行一次独立整合。期间完成因测试基准变更而刷新的原版任务测量与评审。最终生成首版候选提交 f1571580b839。
stages.detail: 5 次已完成重写调用的 Agent 时长合计 107.47 分钟，但并行后的这个墙钟阶段只有约 56.48 分钟。

stages.label: 候选检查与独立验收
stages.description: 首版候选 28 项必需检查中仅 7 项一致。随后 runtime/apps、text、speech 三个领域审查确认回归，最终独立 verifier 给出 FAIL。
stages.detail: 主要缺陷涉及 checkpoint 兼容、原生归档格式、grounding 执行和 hosted API。检查组数不等于功能覆盖率，也不等于单元测试用例数。

stages.label: 第一轮修复 · 被中断
stages.description: 控制器开始第一轮拆分修复；Slurm 在 4 小时时限到达后终止任务。修复尚未完成整合、检查或验收。
stages.detail: 已完成修复为 0 轮，默认上限 10 轮。这个上限是流程指导，实际停止原因是外部调度器 TIMEOUT。当前任务已经停止，没有继续后台运行。

events.label: 开始功能发现
events.description: 发现仓库的完整功能、依赖与代码归属。

events.label: 并行启动出题
events.description: 开发任务设计与功能发现并行。

events.label: 首轮任务验收发现漏洞
events.description: 5 种错误实现仍可通过，需要修订验收。

events.label: 发现完成
events.description: 39 个能力节点、26 项初始检查、34 个生产源码文件。

events.label: 修订后的任务评审通过
events.description: 验收变为 41 项，已能拒绝此前漏过的错误实现。

events.label: 发现功能验证空白
events.description: 负对照显示：禁用优化器更新仍能过测试；HTTP 与调优检查也需补强。

events.label: 扩展基线达到 28/29
events.description: 检查扩至 29 项；quantize_mlx 为原版已知失败。

events.label: 新增测试审查未通过
events.description: 部分测试依赖特定初始化和 DOM 结构，需要提升可移植性。

events.label: 再次发现浏览器探针缺陷
events.description: 旧输入引用会拒绝等价实现，需要修正探针。

events.label: 准备阶段审查完成
events.description: 测试修正通过独立审查，完整范围保持 39 个能力。

events.label: 刷新后的原版任务测量完成
events.description: 本次解题 963,081 tokens，验收 41/41；替代旧测试基准下的第一次测量。

events.label: 原版任务独立评审通过
events.description: 只建立原版任务测量，尚未形成候选对比。

events.label: 首版候选整合完成
events.description: 4 个实现部分及整合部分完成，生成提交 f1571580b839。

events.label: 候选必需检查 7/28
events.description: 7 项一致、21 项未通过，准备步骤成功。

events.label: 独立验收 FAIL，启动修复
events.description: 领域审查确认实际回归，第一轮修复开始。

events.label: Slurm TIMEOUT
events.description: 4 小时时限到达后任务被终止；修复未完成。

capabilities.label: Install and import Needle
capabilities.description: Install the lightweight cactus-needle package, import its public API without the training stack, and control anonymous usage telemetry.

capabilities.label: Define typed tools and records
capabilities.description: Convert Python signatures, decorated callables, Field constraints and Pydantic records into the flat JSON tool schemas consumed by Needle.

capabilities.label: Fetch engines and deployment assets
capabilities.description: Select a compatible platform engine, cache published model weights and checkpoints, and download platform bundles or Hub archives for offline deployment.

capabilities.label: Use the needle command
capabilities.description: Expose the needle console entry point, deterministic command help, argument validation and lazy dispatch to runtime, training, speech and hosted workflows.

capabilities.label: Stateful text tool calling
capabilities.description: Run Needle 3 by default or Needle 2 explicitly through the native engine and return its JSON response, preserving conversation state and per-agent tool configuration.

capabilities.label: Run independent tuned models
capabilities.description: Identify tuned .cact generations from their tag and keep each tuned agent's native weights and conversation in its own subprocess, with reset, embedding and close support.

capabilities.label: Execute a tool loop
capabilities.description: Execute registered Python tools in model call order, feed serialized results back, bound the number of steps and refuse engine-flagged ungrounded arguments by default.

capabilities.label: Extract grounded structured records
capabilities.description: Extract one record as a dict or Pydantic instance, consider suppressed calls, and validate fabricated or negated values and contradictory date years unless strict is disabled.

capabilities.label: Embed text locally
capabilities.description: Return the Needle 3 embedding vector through base or tuned inference, and reject Needle 2 models.

capabilities.label: Transcribe recorded speech
capabilities.description: Accept WAV paths or 16 kHz mono float samples, run Whistle on the Needle 3 engine, and return text, language, timing and optional word probabilities.

capabilities.label: Transcribe live speech
capabilities.description: Stream arbitrary-length 16 kHz sample chunks, yield committed words and a pending tail per chunk, flush at end and stop the native stream on interruption.

capabilities.label: Embed recorded audio
capabilities.description: Return flattened Whistle encoder frame vectors for audio within the engine's embedding window.

capabilities.label: Record and compare speech in the terminal
capabilities.description: Offer microphone and file transcription with interactive language, keyword, timestamp and live modes, plus English comparisons with Whisper and Moonshine.

capabilities.label: Read and write safe model files
capabilities.description: Read and write safetensors checkpoint trees and LoRA adapters with metadata while rejecting pickle file names and payloads.

capabilities.label: Tokenize model text
capabilities.description: Load or fetch the published SentencePiece tokenizer and expose stable marker IDs, text/batch encoding, decoding and vocabulary validation.

capabilities.label: Deployment quantization numerics
capabilities.description: Apply differentiable fake quantization and deterministic CQ weight/KV quantization using the deployment reduction axes, codebooks and FP16 group norms.

capabilities.label: Evaluate and slice the text model
capabilities.description: Provide the JAX/Flax Needle 3 reference network, saved-configuration compatibility, nested depth/width subnetworks, hidden states and probe heads.

capabilities.label: Generate from a training checkpoint
capabilities.description: Load a format-v2 Needle 3 checkpoint, construct the training-compatible prompt and generate text greedily or with seeded temperature sampling through the JAX reference model.

capabilities.label: Read and render local training examples
capabilities.description: Read UTF-8 query/answers and supported single-turn chat JSONL, render the precise chat/tool wire format, and create padded token/loss arrays with target-only supervision.

capabilities.label: Generate synthetic tool data
capabilities.description: Generate and augment JSONL examples through OpenRouter with concurrent bounded requests, schema attachment, duplicate removal and progress reporting.

capabilities.label: Fine-tune a local text adapter
capabilities.description: Train seeded LoRA attention adapters on a frozen Needle 3 base under CQ W4/A8 numerics, report validation and optional exact-call scores and save a safetensors adapter.

capabilities.label: Read and write deployment archives
capabilities.description: Export model tensors, optional probe/audio attachments and a self-contained tokenizer in the positional Needle 3 .cact format; read archives and reproduce their BPE tokenizer.

capabilities.label: Build deployable text models
capabilities.description: Fetch the published base on every build, copy it unchanged when suitable or merge an adapter and slice a depth before W4 export, optionally bundle a platform engine or upload the archive.

capabilities.label: Evaluate the model with MLX
capabilities.description: Convert checkpoint trees to flat MLX parameters and reproduce reference text logits and deployment quantization for masks and depth subnetworks on CPU or Metal.

capabilities.label: Evaluate the speech training model
capabilities.description: Provide the Whistle JAX encoder-decoder, audio feature extraction, language-tag configuration and safe checkpoint loading used for local speech tuning and export.

capabilities.label: Fine-tune speech and add languages
capabilities.description: Train Whistle LoRA adapters from train/validation/test clips, append declared token pieces and new language tags, and report normalized word or character error rates.

capabilities.label: Build deployable speech models
capabilities.description: Copy published Whistle weights or merge speech adapters, extended vocabulary and decoder depth into a W4 .cact, with platform bundles and optional Hub upload.

capabilities.label: Use hosted training and model storage
capabilities.description: Drive the hosted files, generation, fine-tuning, models, billing and job APIs from Python or CLI with stable errors, rate-limit retry, polling and atomic signed downloads.

capabilities.label: Try tool calling in a browser
capabilities.description: Serve packaged browser assets and a local HTTP API for editable tool schemas, preset queries, model uploads, independent completions and reset.

capabilities.label: Fine-tune from the browser
capabilities.description: Generate data, train and build a tuned model in a background browser session with progress polling, download and automatic model loading.

capabilities.label: Use ready-made tool environments
capabilities.description: Discover six lazy tool catalogs, cache an agent per environment and score frozen acceptance cases with confidence, grounding, critical-failure and pass-rate rules.

capabilities.label: Control home devices
capabilities.description: Lights, thermostat, fans, blinds and robot vacuum with bounded settings and explicit targets.

capabilities.label: Control music playback
capabilities.description: Play named music, pause, resume, skip and set bounded volume.

capabilities.label: Capture personal organizer actions
capabilities.description: Timers, dated reminders/events, undated tasks and notes, copying time phrases verbatim.

capabilities.label: Control wearable actions
capabilities.description: Reply to or dismiss known senders, track named workouts, end a workout and find a phone.

capabilities.label: Control kitchen appliances
capabilities.description: Set bounded oven temperatures and cooking timers, control coffee and dishwasher and read appliance status.

capabilities.label: Capture typed personal records
capabilities.description: Contacts, expenses, meals, water intake and weight with verbatim fields and bounded values.

capabilities.label: Validate and publish package releases
capabilities.description: Keep runtime/training dependencies separate, gate publication on pinned engine wheels, choose versions against tags and PyPI, and tag the exact versioned source without modifying main.

capabilities.label: Publish signed WebAssembly components
capabilities.description: Publish the external Needle engine's WASI component and WIT contract to a generation-specific OCI image and sign and verify its digest.

usage.label: 首版重写与未完成修复

methodology: 运行终点来自 Slurm accounting；不使用事后 report rebuild 时间作为结束时间。
7/28 表示首版候选必需检查的一致数量，不是功能覆盖率。
功能树分组仅用于展示；父子节点、共享文件及关联检查不传播通过或失败。
原版生产源码未修改；本轮测试经过补充与适配，并接受了独立审查。
模型用量是 29 次已完成调用的可观测小计；控制器及 3 次修复调用未完成，整轮总量未知。
缓存输入是输入的子集；模型调用 tokens 与源码 tokens 分开统计。
原版任务仅完成一次最终有效测量；候选尚未测量，无法计算任务成本下降。
无已验收候选，压缩收益与最终代码规模未知。
